title: Release tag v2.4.0 cannot deploy to prod (GitLab OIDC)
scenario: Lighthouse switched to tag-based releases. The first release tag fails in deploy-prod with AccessDenied from AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity while deploy-dev on main still works. On-call blames the OIDC provider thumbprint. Find the real cause in the token claims, CloudTrail and trust policies, and fix it without opening prod to branches or forks.
task: Compare the decoded id_token claims of the working and failing jobs
Evaluate both against the trust policies with make check
Fix the prod trust policy for release tags only, audience still pinned
Explain what IAM can and cannot enforce from a GitLab token
acceptance: Tag tokens allowed; branches, forks, other groups and wrong audiences denied
Dev role and pipeline guard rails unchanged
ANSWER.md names the sub claim mismatch with evidence and dismisses the thumbprint
